item.title: Introductory course to VHDL and HLS FPGA programming
item.description: This week I will be giving a series of lectures as part of an introductory course to VHDL and HLS FPGA programming, organized by the ICSC (International Center for Scientific Computing), INFN (Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare) and several italian Universities.

item.title: Talk at SOSC 2024
item.description: I gave a talk about FPGA-based reconfigurable computing at the SOSC 2024 Sixth International School on Open Science Cloud held in Bologna, Italy, on December 2, 2024.

item.title: Talk at SOSC 2023
item.description: I gave a talk about FPGA-based reconfigurable computing at the SOSC 2023 Fifth International School on Open Science Cloud held in Perugia, Italy, on October 23, 2023.
